rating_values.numeric: Signed decimal operands recognized; invalid values are rejected rather than clamped.

composition: Resolve all adjacent and/but/comma bounds over the same field; conjunction takes strongest lower and upper bounds. Equality at a shared endpoint is satisfiable only when both are inclusive.

source_evidence.rating: Explicit rating/rated/review rating/scoring field or star unit. Existing plus notation, pure numeric suffix and pure coordinated comparator phrases remain narrowly supported.
source_evidence.publication: Explicit published/released/issued/printed/publication year prefix, reordered publication-year field, or contiguous same-field coordination.
source_evidence.legacy_year_shorthand: Preserved pure after/before clauses, nonhistorical format-qualified books and nonhistorical from-Y-onward catalogue construction.
source_evidence.protected: Source protected spans cannot be consumed; fieldless star/plus notation inside unresolved explicit author/title phrases is not accepted as a filter.
source_evidence.topical: history after1945 and about-events year intervals remain semantic; a publication field does not license a later topical year separated by about/on text.

helper_api.valid_numeric_domain: (field, value) -> bool; None is absent; bool/NaN/infinity invalid
helper_api.comparator: known grammar -> exact operator; unknown -> None

scope: Shared numeric grammar/helper plus ratings()/years() wrappers only. No authorization or retrieval changes; final full development evaluation is owned by root after freeze.
root_integration_repair_provenance: Preserve EXECUTE_WITH_NOTICE for accepted reordered operator/field syntax; source-backed repair provenance restored before freeze.
